notes: The column headings over the Hiring in boxes were sitting to the right of the boxes they name, at every window size. The header row is its own grid and had nothing in its last column where the Remove button sits, so the flexible columns swallowed that width and everything drifted. It now carries a hidden copy of the button, so the two grids come out identical, and each label is measured to land exactly on its box. The labels are shorter - Item, From, Days, Cost per day, Charge per day - so none of them clip, and the strip hides itself when the middle pane is dragged too narrow for them to read, which the old window-width rule never caught. Crew can also be reordered now: the same up and down arrows the extra charges have, on each crew card, greyed out at the ends. The quote and the Your Crew list in the confirmation both follow whatever order you put them in, and the rate, role and days travel with the card.
